title: The RADIANCE CED Study
official: The Recor Paradise System™ Hypertension Coverage With Evidence Development Study
summary: The RADIANCE CED study is a prospective observational study designed to evaluate the long-term effectiveness of ultrasound renal denervation in lowering blood pressure among patients with uncontrolled hypertension. Data will be collected from electronic health records (EHRs) of Medicare-eligible patients to support generalizability of outcomes to the broader Medicare population. Individual hospital enrollment is not required for this study and IRB exemption has been received by sponsor.

interventions.name: Ultrasound Renal Denervation (Paradise™ Ultrasound Renal Denervation (uRDN) System)

criteria:
Common Inclusion Criteria:

* Adults aged ≥65 years with uncontrolled hypertension
* Stable regimen of blood pressure-lowering medication

Common Exclusion Criteria:

* Hypertension due to secondary causes
* Prior renal denervation treatment
* Pregnancy
* End-stage renal disease, dialysis, or kidney transplant
